# StartupCookie
> AI-native content & GTM agency for B2B SaaS startups. One person, maximum six clients at a time, programs from $5,000/mo.

StartupCookie runs content marketing, product marketing, founder LinkedIn, AEO (AI search optimization), video content, and custom GTM/content agents for seed-to-Series-B B2B SaaS companies. Co-founder Barbara Jovanovic's appearance on HubSpot's Marketing Against the Grain is the most-watched episode in the show's history (151k+ views).

## Services
- Thought Leadership Content: https://startupcookie.com/services/thought-leadership/
- Founder LinkedIn: https://startupcookie.com/services/founder-linkedin/
- AEO / AI Search Optimization: https://startupcookie.com/services/aeo-content/
- Product Marketing: https://startupcookie.com/services/product-marketing/
- Video Content: https://startupcookie.com/services/video-content/
- GTM & Content Agents: https://startupcookie.com/services/gtm-agents/
